title: Casio's $43 Watch Costs 70% MORE in the US 😳
description:
Casio's new LF-40W costs almost 70% more in the US than in Japan. 😳

The LF-40W just landed on Casio's US store at $42.95, in black, blue or beige. Its face has three rows of bars: one shows your settings, two count the seconds (tens and ones). 8.6 mm thin, 23 g, 5 alarms, 48-city world time and a CR1616 battery rated for about 3 years (Casio's figures). The catch: in Japan it's ¥4,400 (about $25 before tax), and it's only rated for everyday water resistance.

By our Spec or Wreck score: 64/100 → SPEC, if you want a fun, cheap watch. Not if you swim.
